answer: Timber-Lottery Slot Assignment. Identities are assigned work slots by a verifiable random draw weighted by a slowly-metabolized resource deposit — the deposit is not slashed, it is time-locked and depreciates like timber seasoning, so capital cost accrues whether or not the clone is detected. An attacker launching a voyage of N clones must pre-fund N deposits whose combined lockup exceeds the expected yield of the sybil cluster, and each clone's slot decays independently across the karst of sequential rounds, forcing continuous recapitalization.
